```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'East Williston' AND border_type = 'city'
),
raster_subset AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geom FROM region_geom),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom))
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM raster_subset
)
SELECT
  MIN(ST_Value(slope_rast, 1)) AS least_steep_slope
FROM slope_raster;
```
